words.zh: v. 弹起；使弹起；蹦跳；拒付 (支票)；上下晃动；跳动；反弹传球；  n. 弹跳，弹力；活力
words.example: The basketball hit the rim and began to bounce across the court.

words.zh: phr. 到处走动；弹来弹去
words.example: The little boy likes to bounce around the gym before his gymnastics class.

words.zh: n. 天资；自然倾向；适宜；【财】天资，才能
words.example: She showed a natural aptitude for languages at a very young age.

words.zh: phr. 领先；起步前的优势
words.example: Studying abroad can give you a head start in your future career.

words.zh: n. 剧情梗概；（可能发生的）事态，情况；设想；方案；预测
words.example: Let's imagine a scenario in which renewable energy becomes the world's main source.

words.zh: n. 律师
words.example: The lawyer presented convincing evidence to support her client's case.

words.zh: v. 组装，装配（机器等）；集合；召集；收集；【计】组合；【航】组装
words.example: It took the students an hour to assemble the model rocket from parts.

words.zh: n. 抽屉；开票人，出票人；制图员
words.example: Please put the scissors back in the kitchen drawer after using them.

words.zh: phr. 抽屉柜
words.example: She bought a chest of drawers to store her clothes in the dormitory.

words.zh: v. 挺胸穿过；  n. 乳房；胸部；胸脯肉；【医】乳房
words.example: The bird had a bright red breast that stood out in the forest.

words.zh: n. 氢，氢气；【物】氢
words.example: Hydrogen is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe.

words.zh: n. 镭
words.example: Marie Curie discovered radium and later won a second Nobel Prize.

words.zh: n. 腕部；腕关节；腕；【医】腕
words.example: He wore a bandage around his wrist after the basketball game.

words.zh: n. 新郎
words.example: The bridegroom waited nervously at the altar for the ceremony to begin.

words.zh: n. 几何学；几何形状；【化】几何结构
words.example: In geometry class, we learned how to calculate the area of a triangle.

words.zh: n. 债；负债；欠款；义务；罪，过失
words.example: After university, he worked hard to pay off his student debt quickly.

words.zh: vt. 加以类别；把……分类（加以归类）
words.example: In biology, scientists categorise living things into different kingdoms and groups.

words.zh: n. 侧面轮廓；简介，概述；外形，轮廓；公众关注度；印象，形象；【计】配置信息，配置文件；  v. 【计】代码分析（剖析）；描绘……的轮廓，扼要描述
words.example: A good LinkedIn profile can help you find a suitable job after graduation.

words.zh: n. 参与者，参加者；  adj. 参加的；有关系的
words.example: Each participant in the science fair must present a project to the judges.

words.zh: v. 【计】编码；将…编码；将……译成密码；  n. 编码，代码；规范，准则；法典；密码，暗码；电话区号；【生化】代码
words.example: She learned how to code a simple website during the computer class.

words.zh: n. 【the Orient】东方；  v. 定……的方位；使适应；使面对；  adj. 东方的；（太阳等）上升的，新生的；闪闪发光的
words.example: The orientation week helps new students orient themselves to campus life.

words.zh: n. 侦探，警探；  adj. 侦探的
words.example: The detective carefully examined the clues left at the crime scene.

words.zh: adj. 形象的；图表的，图案的；绘画的；  n. 图，图表
words.example: The graphic design club will create posters for the school charity event.

words.zh: n. 地产；住宅；庄园；（面上有大片建筑物的）土地；个人财产，遗产；工业区；住宅区
words.example: Her grandfather left a large estate in the countryside to the family.

words.zh: n. 会计人员，会计师；当人们想要回避自己职业的问题时所用的替代词
words.example: After studying math, she decided to become an accountant for a large firm.

words.zh: v. 暗中监视（或侦察）；从事间谍活动；突然看见；发现；  n. 间谍，密探；间谍

words.zh: n. 正义；公平，公正；合理；妥当；应得的赏罚；审判；审判员；司法
words.example: The students wrote essays about social justice and equality in modern society.

words.zh: v. 指责；控告；把……归咎于
words.example: Do not accuse someone without proof; always listen to both sides first.

words.zh: phr. 得出结论；作出推论；告终
words.example: It is important to come to a conclusion based on solid evidence.

words.zh: adj. 贪婪的，贪心的，贪吃的
words.example: The greedy character in the novel lost all his friends because of his selfish actions.

words.zh: n. 企业家，创业者

words.zh: n. 接待员；传达员

words.zh: n. 履历；简历 (= curriculum vitae)

words.zh: n. 社会主义者；  adj. 社会主义的
words.example: The article discusses the history of socialist thought in the nineteenth century.

words.zh: adj. 共产主义的；  n. 共产主义者，共产党员
words.example: Her research focuses on the rise of communist political movements in Asia.

words.zh: v. 献给（把书籍、戏剧、演出等）；致力于，献出（全部时间、精力等）

words.zh: n. 狐狸；狡猾的人；时髦女郎；  v. 假装；欺骗，迷惑
words.example: The clever fox in the story managed to steal the farmer's chickens at night.

words.zh: n. 议会；理事会；委员会；市政服务机构
words.example: The student council organized a successful fundraising event for the library.

words.zh: n. 运河，河流；水渠，灌溉渠；（人体的）导管，食管，气管

words.zh: v. 监督；指导；管理
words.example: A qualified teacher will supervise the students during the laboratory experiment.

words.zh: n. 笔迹；书写，手写；书法
words.example: Her neat handwriting made it easy for the teacher to read her answers.

words.zh: n. 圆盘，唱片；磁盘；【计】盘

words.zh: n. 停车；停车位
words.example: The parking lot near the school is always full during the morning rush.

words.zh: n. 骆驼；浮船箱
words.example: The desert travelers rode a camel across the vast sandy dunes for hours.

words.zh: v. 油煎；油炸；油炒；  n. 鱼苗，鱼秧；弗赖伊（姓氏）；油炸食物；（口语）烦恼，愤激；炸薯条；  adj. 油炸的，油煎的（fried）

words.zh: n. 钱包（尤指女用的），小钱袋，手袋；  v. 使皱起，噘起

words.zh: v. 缝，缝纫；缝补

words.zh: v. 编结，针织；使……紧密结合；  n. 编织的衣服；针织衫

words.zh: n. （羊等动物的）毛；毛料；毛绒；【化】毛

words.zh: adj. 中间的；中级的；中等的；  n. 媒介；  v. 调解，干涉

words.zh: n. 优先；优先权；优先考虑的事；重要事项，首要事项；在前；【财】优先权，优先考虑的事情；【计】优先级

words.zh: n. 熟练，娴熟；精通；【财】熟练，精通

words.zh: n. 笼，鸟笼；囚笼；笼子；  v. 关进（笼子）

words.zh: n. 衣领；（动物）项圈；【机】轴环；项圈；  v. 抓住；为……戴上项圈，为……上领子

words.zh: n. 灭蚤颈圈

words.zh: v. 资金供给，筹措资金；  n. 金融；经济情况；财政；资金

words.zh: n. 收据，收条；收入；收到；接收；【财】收据

words.zh: n. 合格证书，文凭；证明，证明书（读作/sərˈtɪfɪkɪt/）；  v. 给……发证书（读作/sərˈtɪfɪˌkeɪt/）
words.example: She received a certificate after completing the online computer course.

words.zh: n. 雇主，老板
words.example: The employer praised the team for finishing the project ahead of schedule.

words.zh: n. 荒漠，沙漠（读作/ˈdezərt/）；应得的惩罚或奖励；  v. 离弃（读作/dɪˈzɜːt/）；擅离职守；  adj. 荒凉的
words.example: The desert receives very little rainfall throughout the year.

words.zh: v.  （通过努力、能力）获得；学到；得到；购得；患上（疾病）
words.example: Students can acquire valuable skills by participating in volunteer work.
